topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Oh, someone sent you flowers and didn't even leave a note? What a tease, right? But you know what? It's kind of perfect. It’s like a mystery wrapped up in petals and leaves. Who’s been paying attention to you enough to know exactly what you’d adore, but shy about saying it out loud? Maybe it’s a secret admirer or a friend who knows you better than words can say. Whoever it is, they got it spot on. Just let yourself enjoy the surprise, the beauty, the thought behind it. It’s a sweet little gift from the universe, just for you. And hey, a mystery is way more fun than just another name in a card!
